mlp.extrapolation: Linear interpolation through batch 1/8/32; the 8-to-32 slope extends to batch 64.

limitations: The study inherits E61's fitted-service, synthetic-tenant, immediate-rejection, fixed-burst, and single-replica limitations.
Absolute windows are capped at 90% of the measured inter-burst period to preserve monotonic request order.
The frontier uses a finite candidate grid rather than continuous token-bucket optimization.
Robust SLO feasibility uses the maximum p99 TTFT across two service replicates and three seeds, but not a production confidence interval.
Only the equal-share actual-service controller is evaluated because E61 found little incremental value from commitments after pacing.
model: Absolute ingress pacing windows with robust maximum-replicate p99 TTFT SLO selection; end-to-end latency remains anchored to the original client arrival.

validation.slo_selection: A window is feasible only when the maximum per-scenario p99 client TTFT is within the SLO. The feasible window with maximum median output-token throughput is selected.
